description_en: Updates the automatic memory collection toggle
description_zh: 更新自动记忆拾取开关
name: UpdateMemoryAutoExtractionSwitch

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The owner type. A value of user indicates personal memories of the authenticated user. A value of group indicates memories of a specified collaborative workspace
parameters.help_zh: user 为鉴权用户的个人记忆；group 为指定协作空间记忆
parameters.name: owner_type

parameters.help_en: The collaborative workspace ID. This parameter is required when ownerType is set to group
parameters.help_zh: 协作空间 ID；ownerType 为 group 时必填
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic memory collection
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启自动记忆拾取
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to synchronously clear the automatically collected memories. This parameter can be used regardless of whether the feature is enabled or disabled
parameters.help_zh: 是否同步清空已自动拾取的记忆；开启或关闭时均可使用
parameters.name: clear_existing

clearedCount.description_en: The number of automatic memory files cleared in this synchronous operation. The value is 0 if no files are cleared or no memories are available to be cleared
clearedCount.description_zh: 本次同步清空的自动记忆文件数量；未清空或无可清空记忆时为 0

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

enabled.description_en: The updated status of the automatic memory collection toggle. A value of true indicates that the feature is enabled, and a value of false indicates that the feature is disabled
enabled.description_zh: 更新后的自动记忆拾取开关状态；true 为开启，false 为关闭

message.example: 当前用户不是群组 cg_12345 的活跃成员
